stem.text: In some rice-growing parts of the world, farmers use a combination of paddy fields and a fish farm. Rice paddy fields are flooded for much of the growing cycle and water running off the fields flows through pens where fish are raised. Nitrogen-based fertilisers are generally very soluble in water.
Which problems could result from farmers applying excess nitrogen-based fertilisers to their paddy fields?

items: decreased fish production in the fish pens
decreased levels of oxygen in the water
increased growth of algae in the fish pens
